description: This Java class defines a 'Field' object used for representing configuration fields, including methods for generating commands and parsing responses related to these fields.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a configuration field with properties like name, offset, type, bit offset, and options; includes methods for command generation and response parsing.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Generates a command string to set the field value based on its type.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Generates a command string to get the field value based on its type.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a response message string to extract index and value, supporting integer and float messages.
